name: Kankou Bus Tour ~Shikijou ni Somerareta Hanayome~
original_name: 姦交バスツアー ～色情に染められた花嫁～
source:
Miho and Kazuya is a couple before the marriage.
They participate in a tour limited for couples, and they are surprised to learn about the real purpose of the tour during the feast...
